description: Defines enumerations and conversion methods for interest incentive attributes, entity types, and incentive types within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestIncentivesEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert incentive attribute, entity, and type enums to EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: attributeName
methods.description: Converts an Integer or enum to EnumOptionData representing attribute name.

methods.name: entityType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or enum to EnumOptionData representing entity type.

methods.name: incentiveType
methods.description: Converts an Integer or enum to EnumOptionData representing incentive type.
